name: Air-Fryer Chicken Breasts

ingredients.name: bone-in skin-on chicken breasts, trimmed of excess fat

instructions.primary_message: Brine Chicken: Place chicken breasts on a wire rack set in a rimmed baking sheet. Using paper towels, pat chicken dry. Rub chicken all over with salt and baking powder. Refrigerate skin-side up, uncovered, for at least 4 and up to 24 hours.
Preheat a 6-quart air fryer to 190°C (370°F) (190ºC) for 3 minutes. Rub chicken all over with olive oil, black pepper, and desired seasoning, if using (see below for variations).

Place chicken in preheated basket, skin-side down, and cook until chicken has reached an internal temperature of 43°C (43ºC), about 15 minutes. Using tongs, flip chicken skin-side up, and continue cooking at 188°C until chicken skin is golden-brown and crackly and internal temperature is 68°C (68ºC), 15 to 20 minutes. Transfer from air fryer to a cutting board and let rest about 10 minutes before slicing and serving. (Temperature of chicken will continue to rise to 74°C.)

schema_metadata.keywords: air fryer chicken breast, chicken breast in air fryer, chicken breast air fryer, how long to cook chicken breast in air fryer

description: Our zero-fuss recipe for air-fryer chicken breasts produces meat that’s tender, flavorful, and juicy—just the way we like our chicken.
notes:
Total time, including resting: 4 hr 35 min.

Notes: Chicken breast sizes vary. Depending on what's available where you are shopping, you may end up two to four pieces. The recipe will work as long as you have about two pounds total, although cooking times might change (larger breasts will take longer to cook through than smaller ones).

Make-ahead and storage: Chicken breasts can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to four days.
author: Megan O. Steintrager
